ticker_news.title: Prediction: 3 Stocks That'll Be Worth More Than Apple 5 Years From Now
ticker_news.description: Apple's slow growth over the past few years has opened the door for Microsoft, Alphabet, and Nvidia to potentially surpass it in market capitalization within the next five years. These companies are projected to outperform Apple in terms of revenue and profit growth.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury

ticker_news.title: Nvidia Passes Its Latest Test. Here's What It Means for Investors.
ticker_news.description: Nvidia's Q4 earnings report showed continued strong growth, but with less room for surprises as investor expectations have aligned with the company's trajectory. The stock traded down despite beating estimates, as the 'surprise factor' in Nvidia's earnings has diminished. While Nvidia remains well-positioned to lead the AI computing infrastructure, its growth rate is expected to slow, and it may need new catalysts to drive the stock higher in the near term.
ticker_news.author: Jeremy Bowman

ticker_news.title: Three AI stocks to play if you want to look past the Nvidia hardware build-out
ticker_news.description: The article discusses three AI stocks that could be attractive for long-term investors, as they focus on the actual implementation and use of AI technology by corporate clients, rather than just the hardware build-out.
ticker_news.author: Philip Van Doorn
